cassettes.label: Home games
cassettes.about: Three games to play at home.

programs.name: BIORHYTHM
programs.about: Your body, feelings and mind charted for a month from your birthday; C copies the chart to the printer.

programs.name: INVADERS
programs.about: Aliens march down the screen: O and P move, SPACE fires.

programs.name: TETRIS
programs.about: Falling blocks: O and P move, Q turns, A drops faster, SPACE drops at once.

programs.name: BANNER
programs.about: Your words printed down the paper in letters as tall as the roll is wide.

programs.name: CALENDAR
programs.about: Any month from 1753 on, on the screen and the printer, or a whole year.

programs.name: MAZE
programs.about: A new maze each time, to solve on the screen or copy to the printer.

cassettes.label: Demos
cassettes.about: Pictures and music from a little mathematics.

programs.name: MANDEL
programs.about: The Mandelbrot set, drawn in colour by BASIC, taking its time.

programs.name: ZOOM
programs.about: The Mandelbrot set again, drawn by machine code fast enough to zoom into: arrows move, Z zooms in, X out.

programs.name: PATTERNS
programs.about: Times tables, roses, spirographs and Lissajous figures; C copies one to the printer.

programs.name: TUNE
programs.about: Tunes on a keyboard that lights up, or play it yourself.

programs.name: HANGMAN
programs.about: Guess the word before the gallows are built.

programs.name: SIMON
programs.about: Repeat the order the coloured pads light up in, one more each round.

programs.name: OXO
programs.about: Noughts and crosses against the Spectrum.

programs.name: EDITOR
programs.about: A full-screen BASIC editor in 42 columns, for typing in programs: keywords are typed as words, and the cursor goes anywhere on the listing.

cassettes.label: Blank C60
cassettes.about: A blank cassette for your own programs: SAVE onto it.

cartridges.name: HOME
cartridges.about: The guessing game. Type RUN for its menu.

files.name: run
files.about: The cartridge's menu, which RUN loads by itself.

files.name: guess
files.about: The guessing game: think of a thing in your home, or an animal.

cartridges.name: DATA
cartridges.about: What the guessing game knows, and what it learns.

files.name: things
files.about: The things in a home the guessing game knows.

files.name: animals
files.about: The animals the guessing game knows.

cartridges.name: INTRO2
cartridges.about: Sinclair's own Microdrive demonstration cartridge, its second edition of 1984, by John Mathieson and Andrew Pennell. In Microdrive 1 in place of HOME, type RUN for its menu.

files.name: run
files.about: The menu, which RUN loads by itself: what each program shows, and how to load it.

files.name: title SCREEN$
files.about: The title screen the menu loads first.

files.name: net game
files.about: Guess the other player's number, over the ZX Net, which the emulator does not have.

files.name: P server
files.about: Shares an RS232 printer over the ZX Net, which the emulator does not have.

files.name: Dbase prog
files.about: Looks up each keyword the Interface 1 adds to BASIC: type the keyword as usual.

files.name: Database
files.about: The keywords Dbase prog reads, a file written with PRINT # and read with INPUT #.

files.name: copier
files.about: Adds * MOVE, which copies files between cartridges and cassettes.

files.name: copy code
files.about: The machine code of * MOVE, which copier loads.

files.name: cat
files.about: Adds * CAT, which catalogues a cartridge or a cassette with each file's type and length.

files.name: cat code
files.about: The machine code of * CAT, which cat loads.
